About

I'm a sophomore at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign working across propulsion, structures, thermal, and manufacturing. I like projects where analysis has to survive contact with real hardware: I've designed a rocket motor closure in NX, validated it in ANSYS, wound the carbon-fiber tubes myself, and presented the results at SRR, PDR, and CDR. I'm looking for an internship where I can own a piece of a real vehicle or spacecraft.
